notes.title: 🔧 Update – Text Improvements & Minor Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[h2]🔧 Update – Text Improvements & Minor Bug Fixes[/h2][p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]It’s been a while since [i]Nemesis RPG[/i] received an update. Why?
Because I’ve been working hard on a [b]major content update for [i]Nemesis FDT[/i][/b], the free rogue-lite set in the same universe. But today, [i]Nemesis RPG[/i] is getting a well-deserved polish![/p][p]📝 This small patch includes:[/p][list][*][p]A [b]full revision of in-game texts[/b] to improve flow, clarity, and immersion,[/p][/*][*][p]Several [b]minor bug fixes[/b] (UI, small inconsistencies, combat details...).[/p][/*][/list][p]📘 And for English-speaking players:
The [b]English translation of [i]Nemesis FDT[/i][/b] is almost finished and will be published very soon.
Thank you for your patience — it's the biggest update yet, and I can’t wait to share it with you.[/p][p]Thanks to all of you still climbing the tower and sending feedback!
Even when my focus shifts to another project, [i]Nemesis RPG[/i] is never forgotten.[/p][p]➡️ Haven’t tried [i]Nemesis FDT[/i] yet? Now’s a great time!
And if you want the full experience, check out the [b]bundle with the Class Pack DLC[/b]:[/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/48607/Nemesis/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Thanks again for your support, your patience, and your curiosity.
More is coming soon![/p][p]— Morin Aurélien, developer at Éditions Douces[/p]

notes.title: 📢 NEW CONTENT UPDATE AVAILABLE !
notes.notes:
✍️ Complete Rewrite of All Dialogues
Every single line of text in the game has been rewritten by hand — dialogues, descriptions, inner thoughts...
The pacing, consistency, and emotional impact have all been improved. Characters like Artrium, the goddess, or Benel have never felt more alive, more humorous… or more unsettling.

🌠 Post-Ending Content Added
A brand new zone is now accessible after finishing the game.
It sheds light on lingering mysteries, reveals behind-the-scenes truths, and offers a new perspective on the story. Think of it as a hidden epilogue — for the curious, on the edge of fiction and something more personal.

🇬🇧 Full English Retranslation
The entire game has been retranslated from scratch to deliver better readability, more accurate tone, and full fidelity to the original atmosphere.
Nemesis - RPG is now ready to reach far beyond French-speaking borders.

If you thought you had it all figured out… think again.
And if you're just starting the adventure — you're picking the perfect time.

Thank you all for your feedback, support, and critiques.
This patch is as much yours as it is mine.

— Aurélien (Ismylife), creator of Nemesis - RPG

notes.title: Climb the infinite tower in the new free game: Nemesis - FDT!
notes.notes:
🔥 Join the Tower Ascension and Leave Your Mark in Nemesis - Final Dragon Tower! 🔥

In the depths of the endless tower, where each floor is more perilous than the last, a legend is being written… and YOU could be part of it! 🎮

To celebrate the launch of Nemesis - FDT, we’re offering you the chance to become an integral part of this universe with an exclusive contest:

[h3]Legendary Ascension[/h3]

💀 Floor 20: The Monster Forge
The first player to reach the 20th floor will get to design their own monster! A unique creature to haunt the tower’s floors and challenge other adventurers. Choose its design, its attacks, and its name.

👑 Floor 60: The Boss Creator
Reach the elite summit at floor 60! The first player to get there will earn the ultimate honor of creating a formidable boss. Its appearance, power, and personality will be entirely up to you. Can you craft the ultimate nightmare for other players?

💎 Floor 100: Glory and Reward
Prove your worth by climbing the first 100 floors of the tower and win a €20 Steam gift card to explore even more adventures.

⚠️ Important: Share your score, even if you’re not the first! ⚠️
Rewards cannot be stacked. If one player is the first to reach multiple milestones (e.g., floors 20 and 60), the next reward will go to the second-ranked player for that milestone. This means every score counts!

📸 Take a screenshot of your score (including the code) and share it in the [b]“[Concours]”[/b] channel on Discord to enter.

https://discord.gg/rJMFsRxxrX

🎯 You don’t have to be the best to win a reward. Even second and third-place players have a chance!

Ready to become a legend? The tower awaits you. Your ascension begins now. Good luck, adventurers!

notes.title: Bugsfix
notes.notes:
Hello gamer friends,

I have taken note of all your feedback, I am correcting the errors in French as I go (and I really appreciate your feedback)

Despite my hard work, a few bugs remain and I am struggling to fight them! (Tel Nassan with his big sword)

In the meantime, I integrated an automatic saving system on Slot 1 after each fight (so as not to lose progress after a crash)

Remember to make your backups on Slots other than 1 (to avoid any loss of data)

And if the bugs return, please let me know, I removed the automatic backup system when all the problems are resolved, don't overdo it;)

Good game!
